mentions.name: Apptown
mentions.description: A self-hosted software forge, factory, and agent platform ('mini Heroku') that builds and maintains small apps and games. It deploys smallish projects in a predictable, consistent, low-friction way, then helps maintain them long term, handling chores like dependency and container updates. It is self-hostable, can use local models, and can be tried on Mac or Linux in a temp container.
mentions.source_excerpt: A self hosted software forge / factory / agent platform / mini heroku thing. It's not polished yet but it's building and maintaining little apps and games. https://github.com/flokkit/apptown
